folds.heading: ## Proposal and scope reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B17)
folds.body: N21’s required one-realm/one-prestige first proof belongs to the October 14 snapshot. USER_VISION’s October 24 first-milestone/scope direction retired that gate. Keep N21 as historical rationale rather than a current sequencing requirement. N3–N20 remain illustrative defaults/dials, not accepted payout law or measured game balance. Preserve the mathematical finding: per-life concavity can reward splitting; cumulative issuance removes that particular split effect without guaranteeing long-life advantage under time, hazard or speed changes. Retain finite payer quotes, explicit prestige choice, exact issued/spent history and capability carry distinctions. Current AD22 limits integrity work to real save/settlement needs; these proposals do not authorize a new anti-exploit project.
